findings.detail: Seed-id fallback compares absent seed.plan_sha256(None) to an earlier raw-rejected row.plan_sha256(None), potentially binding a later legal seed to the wrong rejected row. This can omit a direct-qualified effect label or store an incorrect seed reference when an earlier teacher bucket is unsupported. It does not create a new positive label from rejected raw: raw_legal and selected preference qualification remain mandatory.
findings.fix_after_evidence_sealed: Guard plan SHA comparison with non-None seed.plan_sha256; otherwise match non-None seed.content_key to row.search_content_key. Preserve experiment producer9f39,raw selections and labels; do not rerun/relabel this formal run.

findings.detail: Official teacher_search/results.json is body-sealed and verifies planning registry/proposals/selection source hashes on resume. Duplicate teacher_effect.json is not separately rehashed on the completed-results fast path. Formal dataset uses results.json, so this duplicate does not control training labels. Export verifies original seals and preserves both exact bytes.
